<a id="lifting-a-joint-decomposition-from-a-whole-code--从整体代码提升共同分解"></a>
# Lifting a joint decomposition from a whole code

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`joint-decomposition-lifting` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F02 · [record](joint-decomposition-lifting.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The parts a description reads together lift from every configuration it describes exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into ones it identifies, with no premise; through a code reading the joint tests exactly and reducedly they lift where pairs of parts are compact and tests stable.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A description reads the joint relation among descriptions where some configuration it so describes holds together parts it so describes; the parts lift from every configuration it describes where each pair read at that configuration's description is held together by the configuration with parts it describes alike. (`Becoming.jointImage`, `Becoming.LiftsFromEach`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. A relation matches parts where, for any two configurations it relates, each pair of parts the first holds together is matched by a pair the second holds together, related part by part. The parts lift through a description exactly where having one description matches parts, and, where it identifies exactly the configurations some relation relates, exactly where that relation matches parts; no premise. (`Becoming.MatchesParts`, `Becoming.liftsFromEach_iff`, `Becoming.liftsFromEach_iff_of_kernel`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. Through a description identifying exactly the jointly alike configurations the parts lift, with no premise; through one identifying exactly the configurations passing the same joint tests they lift where the pairs of parts each configuration holds together are compact for pairs of joint tests and every joint test holds wherever it cannot fail. (`Becoming.JointAlike`, `Becoming.IdentifiesJointAlike`, `Becoming.IdentifiesJointAlike.lifts`, `Becoming.SameJointTests`, `Becoming.JointFrame.JointCompact`, `Becoming.JointFrame.TestsStable`, `Becoming.liftsFromEach_of_sameJointTests`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Under the same two conditions, through a code reading the joint tests exactly and giving configurations passing the same joint tests one code, the parts lift from every configuration it describes, and configurations given one code match parts into configurations given one code. (`Becoming.liftsFromEach_of_exact`, `Becoming.matchesParts_of_exact`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Excluded middle makes every joint test stable; and that configurations passing the same joint tests match parts into such configurations, in every joint frame with one move and one claim whose pairs of parts are compact, holds exactly under excluded middle, every proposition decided. (`Becoming.JointFrame.TestsStable.of_em`, `Becoming.matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No premise for liftsFromEach_iff and IdentifiesJointAlike.lifts. The forms through the joint tests and through a code take JointCompact (the pairs of parts each configuration holds together are compact for pairs of joint tests) and TestsStable (every joint test holds wherever it cannot fail); the code forms also take Exact and Reduced.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Lifting gives some parts described alike, not the substitution of designated parts or the duplication of support. Witness: `Becoming.LiftsFromEach`.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Machine-checked by the consolidated core checker: Becoming.Composition, Becoming.JointCorrespondence and Becoming.Likeness are bound to receipts in becoming/becoming-checks, and every cited declaration has an empty axiom report, excluded middle appearing in statements, never as an axiom. The periphery's earlier form (deeper/ExplanatoryJointness, its receipt in deeper/explanatory-jointness-checks) had one sufficient direction; it is a provenance reference.

<a id="history--沿革"></a>
### History

- 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
- 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine, with one added hypothesis. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. A description lifts the parts it reads exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into configurations it identifies (liftsFromEach_iff; the periphery had one sufficient direction), and where it identifies exactly the configurations passing the same joint tests, the pairs of parts being compact and the tests stable, it lifts them (liftsFromEach_of_sameJointTests). An exact reduced presentation identifies exactly those configurations, and codeJoint is the core's jointImage, so code_joint_lifts_from_whole holds on the spine where the model's tests are stable (code_joint_lifts_from_whole_of_stable); excluded middle gives stability, and without stability the step the periphery takes classically is exactly excluded middle (matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; whether finite fibres are compact without excluded middle is open.
- 20 October 2026, R35 (twentieth review, E8): proof references to superseded periphery modules (CompositionBridge and ExplanatoryJointness) re-roled as provenance, with their declarations kept, and their bindings dropped; the current proof is the modules it still cites as proof (Becoming.Composition and Becoming.JointCorrespondence).
